instruction.text: Wähle die passenden Antworten aus. Mehrere Antworten können richtig sein.

atoms.a: Wie kannst du eine Diskussion beginnen?
b: ++First of all, I would like to say that ...

atoms.a: Wie kannst du deine Meinung ausdrücken?
b: To sum up, one could say that ...

atoms.a: Wie kannst du nach der Meinung einer Person fragen?
Wie kannst du dir etwas nochmal erklären lassen?
b: ++Can you please explain more what you said about ...?

atoms.a: Wie kannst du eine Diskussion beenden/zusammenfassen?
b: ++So all in all I believe that ...
Can you say that again, please?

instruction.text: Vervollständige die englischen Sätze, indem du das jeweils richtige Wort auswählst.

atoms.a: Ich würde gerne darüber diskutieren, ob es Schüler:innen erlaubt sein sollte, in der Schule Handys zu benutzen oder nicht.
atoms.b: I would like to ((++discuss disagree)) whether students should be allowed to use mobile phones in school or not.

atoms.a: Wenn du meine ehrliche Meinung willst: Ich denke, dass Schulen die Verwendung von Handys erlauben sollte.
atoms.b: If you want my honest ((++opinion truth)), I think schools should permit the use of mobile phones.

atoms.a: Würde es dir etwas ausmachen, mir das noch einmal zu erklären?
atoms.b: Would you mind ((++explaining agreeing)) that to me one more time?
What are your ((++thoughts facts)) on all of this?

atoms.a: Basierend auf dem, was wir gehört haben, komme ich zu dem Schluss, dass die Nutzung von Handys während des Unterrichts verboten, aber in den Pausen erlaubt sein sollte.
atoms.b: Based on what we have heard, I ((++conclude introduce)) that the use of mobile phones should be banned during lessons, but allowed in breaks.

instruction.text: Tippe alle Satzteile an, die ausdrücken, dass es sich um eine persönliche Meinung handelt.
Höre dir die Sätze an und schreibe die fehlenden Wörter in die Lücken.

atoms.b: I would like to ((talk)) about whether we should use online books instead of printed books in school.
atoms.sound: I would like to talk about whether we should use online books instead of printed books in school.

atoms.b: In my ((view)), students should use online books in school, because they are more convenient.
atoms.sound: In my view, students should use online books in school, because they are more convenient.
What do you mean by that?

atoms.b: Do you have anything to ((say)) about this?
atoms.sound: Do you have anything to say about this?

atoms.b: Weighing the pros and cons, I come to the ((conclusion)) that students should use online books instead of printed books in school, but schools need to provide the students with tablets first.
atoms.sound: Weighing the pros and cons, I come to the conclusion that students should use online books instead of printed books in school, but schools need to provide the students with tablets first.

instruction.text: Ordne die Sätze jeweils passend zu.

atoms.b: Let’s begin with the fact that we need to speak different languages, because we talk to people from all over the world.
As far as I can see, learning a second language in school is beneficial for students.

Taking into account the discussion before, one can say that students should be obligated to learn a second language in school. However, they should be allowed to choose which language they want to learn.
